title: Mining, digging and the Minoan look
summary: Patch 0017 gives the 3D game its first trades and a new look for the Minoans. You mine asteroids with a beam that scans a rock, cuts its veins in a heat band and carves pits into its surface; on foot you cut deposits of crystal and ore straight into your pack, and the terrain digger carves the ground itself into voxels - pits, trenches and tunnels with rough walls and a lamp in the dark. Landing on a station's pad has a proper landing display, R / F thrusters and a throttle that stops at zero, and the pulse cannon's bolts fly three times faster. Locking on a target opens a live window of it with its stats. Your ship is rebuilt as a Minoan armoured hauler with a walkable bridge, quarters and loading bay, the Minoans' own ships and stations take on the same worn cream-and-red look, the loading door swings down into the ramp and station pads lower you down lit shafts under sliding shutters. The ground and the towns run faster, and the towns gain Minoan columns, horns, jars and carved stone.

steps.title: Landing on a station's pad
steps.text: Within 600 m of the pad a station gives you, a landing display comes up: the pad seen from above with your ship in the middle (steer its square under you), a height tape, a level bubble, your speed and the thrust on each axis, and what's keeping you from touching down. R raises the ship and F lowers it (Q / E sideways); the throttle stops at zero on the way through and shows reverse thrust as a negative value; L near a station asks for the pad. Your pulse cannon's bolts fly three times faster, so pirates are much easier to hit.

steps.title: Mining asteroids
steps.text: Asteroid fields of iron, titanium or platinum: fire with your sights on a rock and the ship cuts it with a red mining beam. A targeted rock is scanned in two seconds - its minerals and its veins, marked on it as it tumbles. The beam cuts the vein nearest your sights; hold its heat in the green band for full speed and resonance, push it too hot and part of it fractures into rubble. Fragments go into your hold; the rock shrinks and is gone when mined out, and the field remembers it.

steps.title: Rocks carved, deposits on foot
steps.text: Mining now carves an asteroid's own surface: each vein you cut sinks into a pit that grows as it empties, fractures blow chunks out and the bulk rock is scarred where you hit it - the rock's mesh rebuilt on a worker, the craters saved. On a planet's ground, deposits stand in the open - crystal clusters and boulders veined with ore - and your mining beam on foot cuts them into your pack as the mineral itself, nothing to refine. They shrink as you cut and break up at the last unit; the beam overheats if you hold it too long.

steps.title: Digging: voxel ground
steps.text: V swaps your rifle for the terrain digger. Its beam carves the ground where you aim - a sphere at a time, boring in along the beam, so you can sink pits and tunnel into hillsides. Where the ground is carved, it becomes voxels: 8 m chunks of half-metre cells meshed on workers, the heightfield hidden inside each carve. The walls crumble with noise rather than staying perfectly round; the walker's floor, the camera and the boulders all follow the carved ground, and a shoulder lamp comes on in the dark. Carves are saved.

steps.title: Frame rate: ground and towns
steps.text: Low over a planet, the ground's quadtree visit (splitting and merging its patches) ran whole in one frame - at 600 FPS one frame in twenty. It now runs from a list, 0.3 ms a frame, carrying on in the next frames; the horizon test uses precomputed cosines. In towns the buildings' plaster is mottled from the world's 3D noise texture instead of three noises worked out per pixel, and townspeople beyond 110 m aren't drawn.

steps.title: Towns: the Minoan pieces
steps.text: The town builder gains pieces made in code: Minoan columns turned on a lathe (dark base, red shaft wider at the top, cushion capital), horns of consecration that curve, storage jars with a rope band, the palace frieze of round beam ends, timber window frames and beams laid in the masonry. The building shader cuts stone into courses of ashlar blocks and paints the frescoes' running spirals. On a world with air the shade is lit by the sky, not a dim space grey.

steps.title: The target's window
steps.text: Lock on with T and a window opens top left under the gauge: your target seen live by a camera of its own circling it from its star's lit side, and its card. Ships and creatures show shields and hull bars, class, flag, stance, speed and weapons; planets and moons their type, radius, orbit, year, moons, surface and air; the star its type, size and heat; stations what they sell and buy and their free pads; gates where they lead. The window renders 30 times a second, only while you have a target.

steps.title: Your ship: a Minoan hauler
steps.text: Your ship is rebuilt as a Minoan armoured hauler about 58 m long, from reference pictures: chamfered plates in worn cream with red bands and raised armour, the bridge's windows wrapped over the nose, a spine with masts, four engine nacelles, the triskelion on its flanks, amber lamps in rows. Inside: the bridge with the captain's throne on a lit dais, crew seats, consoles under the windows, bull banners and a star-map hologram; the quarters through an arch; the loading bay with your cargo in crates under a crane. One worn-paint shader draws it all.

steps.title: Minoan ships and stations
steps.text: The look spreads to the Minoans: their traders, freighters and haulers fly the same hauler at their own size, their patrols wear the worn cream-and-red livery. Minoan stations are rebuilt from a reference picture: a great ring of chamfered segments with the wave frieze and rows of lit windows, on spokes round a tower of stacked discs with a spire above and one below, bull banners hung from it, landing platforms railed and floodlit. The whole station is baked into one mesh on a worker. Their hangars get the loading-bay look.

steps.title: Doors: the ramp and the pads
steps.text: Your loading door no longer vanishes: hinged at the deck's end, it swings out and down on two rams and becomes the ramp's first part, then a second section slides out to the ground; shutting runs it back. On stations, each pad sits over a lit shaft and is the lift: you sink down it, telescoping shutters slide out from their stacks beside the pad and meet over you, and only then the hangar. Undocking opens them over you and the lift brings you up.

review.intro: Patch 0017: mining asteroids (scanned, veins cut in a heat band, the rock carved), deposits mined on foot, the terrain digger carving voxel ground, a landing display for station pads with R / F thrusters and a throttle stop at zero, faster pulse bolts, a live window of your target, your ship rebuilt as a Minoan hauler with a walkable bridge, quarters and loading bay, the Minoans' ships and stations in the same look, a loading door that swings down into the ramp, pads lowering you down lit shafts under sliding shutters, Minoan pieces for the towns, and frame-rate work on the ground and the towns.

+## mining | Mining asteroids | keywords: Mining, asteroid, vein, Scanned, resonance, Fragments, Rubble
+Most systems have **asteroid fields** - iron, titanium or platinum rocks, a few hundred to a field. Fire with your sights on a rock within 1.5 km and your ship cuts it with its red **mining beam** instead of its guns; the rock becomes your target (**T** on one does too).
+
+- **The scan** - stay within 3 km of your targeted rock for two seconds and it's scanned: what it's made of, and its **veins**, marked on the rock as it tumbles. An unscanned rock gives only **rubble**.
+- **Cutting a vein** - the beam cuts the vein nearest your sights. Over the toolbar the readout shows its **heat** on a bar with the cutting band in **green**: below it the vein cuts slowly; in it at full speed, and **resonance** builds the longer you hold it there; above it the beam strains - and at the top the vein **fractures**, a share of it lost as rubble. Let go to let it cool: fire in pulses to keep it in the green. Harder minerals heat faster.
+- **Fragments** go into your hold, until it's full. Sold as they are they fetch little: an on-board **refinery** ([Industry](doc:industry)) makes minerals of them.
+- The rock is **carved** as you mine it: each vein you cut sinks into a **pit**, deeper and wider the more of it comes out (its mark sits at the bottom), fractures blow chunks out of it, and hacking at the bulk rock leaves craters where the beam strikes. Mined out, it's **gone** for good - your pits and craters are kept in your save.
+
+![](shot:space3d_mining)
+
+## digging | Mining on foot | keywords: deposit, crystal, ore, mining beam, overheated, Dug
+On a planet's ground stand **deposits** of its minerals - **crystal clusters** (ice, salt, sulphur, obsidian, orichalcum) and **boulders veined with ore** (iron, copper, tin, silver, gold, cobalt, titanium, platinum). Which ones depends on the kind of world: ice and salt on frozen ones, sulphur and obsidian on volcanic ones, metals on cratered worlds and moons. They're always in the same places, so you can come back to them.
+
+- **Fire** with your sights on a deposit within 30 m: your **mining beam** cuts it instead of the rifle. Its ore goes straight into your pack as the **mineral itself** - nothing to refine.
+- The deposit **shrinks** as you cut it, and at the last unit it breaks up and is **gone** for good.
+- Beside the sights: the deposit and what's **left** of it, the beam's **heat** and what you've **dug**. The beam heats as it cuts (harder minerals faster); at the top it **overheats** and stops until it has cooled right down - let go now and then.
+
+![](shot:space3d_dig)
+
+## terrain | Digging the ground | keywords: Terrain digger, dig, tunnel, cave, voxel
+**V** swaps your rifle for the **terrain digger** (again: the rifle). Fire and its beam **carves the ground** where your sights are - a sphere out of it at a time. Hold it on one spot and it bores in along the beam: **down** into a pit, or **into a hillside** as a tunnel. Sweep it and it cuts a **trench**. Where you've dug, the ground is solid **voxels**, so you can make pits, tunnels, caves and overhangs, and walk in them: you stand on their floors, their walls stop you, and the camera stays inside. Plants and boulders in the way go. You can't dig in a town. It shares the mining beam's **heat**, so let go before it overheats. Everything you dig stays dug - it's kept in your save.
+
+![](shot:space3d_digging)
+
 # stations-ch | Stations
 Everything you can do while docked.
 
 ## stations | Docking | keywords: Undock
 Stations are big - two kilometres and more across: a core tower, a slowly turning habitat ring, docking arms ending in platforms of numbered **landing pads** - two of them big enough for the largest freighters - floodlit, in the empire's colours. Their parts are solid: fly into one and you bounce off it, hurt.
-- **Ask for a pad** - near a station, **F**: traffic control gives you one (the smallest free one that takes your ship); it lights up and is marked on your screen (an arrow at the edge when it's off it). **F** again cancels.
-- **Set down on it yourself** - fly over it and come down on the thrusters: **Space / Ctrl** up and down, **Q / E** sideways. Over the pad the readout shows your **height**, how far **off its middle** you are and your **speed**. Inside its square, level with it and slower than **12 m/s**, you touch down - and the pad's **lift** takes your ship down into the station's **hangar**.
+- **Ask for a pad** - near a station, **L**: traffic control gives you one (the smallest free one that takes your ship); it lights up and is marked on your screen (an arrow at the edge when it's off it). **L** again cancels.
+- **Set down on it yourself** - fly over it and come down on the thrusters: **R / F** up and down, **Q / E** sideways. Within 600 m of it the **landing display** shows: the pad **from above** with your ship in the middle, nose up (steer the square under you; a line shows your drift), the **height tape** with how fast you climb or sink, the **level bubble** (keep it in its ring) and your **speed**, the thrust (signed: backward and down negative) and what still stops a touchdown. In the view the pad is outlined, and a line drops from your ship to the deck under it. Inside its square, level with it and slower than **12 m/s**, you touch down - and the pad's **lift** takes your ship down into the station's **hangar**.
 - **The hangar** - get up from your seat (**E**), walk down the ramp: the crew at their work, and **terminals** along the back wall (**E** beside one) - **Repair**, the **Market**, **Outfitting**, the **Shipyard**, the **Designer**, **Reputation**, **Missions** - the station's services, explained on the next pages. Docking recharges your shields.
 - **Undock** - back aboard, **L** or **Space**: up the lift onto your pad, and off.
 - Traders use the pads too: you'll see them come in, set down, sit a while and lift off - the haulers, the biggest of them, on the big pads.

files.explanation: New: the Minoan look's toolkit, used by your ship, its rooms, the Minoan NPC ships, stations and their bays. A model is one mesh in one shader (minoan.gdshader); each face's part - cream or red paint, iron, steel, lamp, screen, triskelion, bull banner, leather, cloth, leaves, hazard stripes, the wave frieze - is a zone number in its vertex colour. The Mesher gathers faces (boxes, panels, discs, cylinders, lathes, armoured lofts of chamfered sections, raised plates) into a SurfaceTool and commits them once; it is plain data, so it runs on worker threads. Shared materials: the hull, inside and station variants, a one-zone material for other builders' meshes, glass and a hologram.

+## The Minoan ships' and stations' look, as parts merged into one mesh a model
+## (shaders/world/minoan.gdshader: each face's zone - paint, metal, lamp,
+## screen, leather, cloth, the triskelion, the bull - in its vertex colour).
+## A Mesher collects faces (armoured lofts of chamfered sections, lathed
+## nacelles, boxes, discs, flat decals) and commits them once; the materials
+## are shared (`mat`: the hull, outside / inside; `glass`; `zone_mat` for other
+## builders' meshes). Builds are plain data: worker threads make them.
+
+enum { CREAM, RED, IRON, STEEL, LAMP, SCREEN, TRISKELION, BULL, LEATHER, CLOTH, LEAVES, HAZARD, WAVE }
+
+const SHADER := preload("res://shaders/world/minoan.gdshader")
+static var _mats := {}
+
+
+## The look's material: "hull" (worn, outside) or "inside" (cleaner, no mirror metal).
+static func mat(kind := "hull") -> ShaderMaterial:
+	if _mats.has(kind):
+		return _mats[kind]
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = SHADER
+	m.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", Cosmos.noise_ready())
+	if kind == "inside":
+		m.set_shader_parameter("wear", 0.35)
+		m.set_shader_parameter("inside", 1.0)
+	elif kind == "station":   # (a station's: plates the size of its scale)
+		m.set_shader_parameter("panel", 9.0)
+	_mats[kind] = m
+	return m
+
+
+## A material that's one zone all over (for meshes without the zone colours).
+static func zone_mat(zone: int, kind := "hull") -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var key := "%s:%d" % [kind, zone]
+	if _mats.has(key):
+		return _mats[key]
+	var m := mat(kind).duplicate() as ShaderMaterial
+	m.set_shader_parameter("zone_override", float(zone))
+	_mats[key] = m
+	return m
+
+
+## The windows: tinted, glossy, see-through (their outside only: from within you look out).
+static func glass() -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	if _mats.has("glass"):
+		return _mats["glass"]
+	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
+	m.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 0.32, 0.36, 0.28)
+	m.metallic = 0.6
+	m.roughness = 0.05
+	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_BACK
+	_mats["glass"] = m
+	return m
+
+
+## A soft additive glow (a hologram).
+static func holo() -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	if _mats.has("holo"):
+		return _mats["holo"]
+	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
+	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
+	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
+	m.albedo_color = Color(0.25, 0.6, 1.0, 0.35)
+	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
+	_mats["holo"] = m
+	return m
+
+
+## Faces gathered for one mesh.
+class Mesher:
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	var n := 0
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+
+	func _c(zone: int, g := 0.0) -> Color:
+		return Color(zone / 16.0, g, 0.0, 1.0)
+
+	## A triangle facing away from `inner` (a point inside the part).
+	func tri(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, zone: int, inner: Vector3, uv := [Vector2.ZERO, Vector2.ZERO, Vector2.ZERO], g := 0.0) -> void:
+		var nrm := (b - a).cross(c - a)
+		if nrm.length_squared() < 1e-12:
+			return
+		nrm = nrm.normalized()
+		var pts := [a, b, c]
+		var uvs: Array = uv
+		if nrm.dot((a + b + c) / 3.0 - inner) < 0.0:
+			nrm = -nrm
+			pts = [a, c, b]
+			uvs = [uv[0], uv[2], uv[1]]
+		# (Godot's front faces wind clockwise seen from the front)
+		var col := _c(zone, g)
+		for k in [0, 2, 1]:
+			st.set_color(col)
+			st.set_normal(nrm)
+			st.set_uv(uvs[k])
+			st.add_vertex(pts[k])
+		n += 1
+
+	func quad(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, d: Vector3, zone: int, inner: Vector3, g := 0.0) -> void:
+		var u := [Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(0, 1)]
+		tri(a, b, c, zone, inner, [u[0], u[1], u[2]], g)
+		tri(a, c, d, zone, inner, [u[0], u[2], u[3]], g)
+
+	## A raised plate on a face: the quad a b c d (on the face), lifted `h` off it, its edges closed.
+	func plate(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, d: Vector3, h: float, zone: int, inner: Vector3) -> void:
+		var nrm := (b - a).cross(d - a).normalized()
+		if nrm.dot((a + c) * 0.5 - inner) < 0.0:
+			nrm = -nrm
+		var up := nrm * h
+		var mid := (a + b + c + d) * 0.25
+		quad(a + up, b + up, c + up, d + up, zone, mid - nrm)
+		var lo := [a, b, c, d]
+		for i in 4:
+			var j := (i + 1) % 4
+			quad(lo[i], lo[j], lo[j] + up, lo[i] + up, zone, mid + up * 0.5)
+
+	## A box (`size` full) placed by `xf`.
+	func box(size: Vector3, xf: Transform3D, zone: int) -> void:
+		var h := size * 0.5
+		var p := []
+		for i in 8:
+			p.append(xf * Vector3(h.x if i & 1 else -h.x, h.y if i & 2 else -h.y, h.z if i & 4 else -h.z))
+		var o := xf.origin
+		for f in [[0, 1, 3, 2], [4, 5, 7, 6], [0, 1, 5, 4], [2, 3, 7, 6], [0, 2, 6, 4], [1, 3, 7, 5]]:
+			quad(p[f[0]], p[f[1]], p[f[2]], p[f[3]], zone, o)
+
+	func boxat(size: Vector3, at: Vector3, zone: int, yaw := 0.0) -> void:
+		box(size, Transform3D(Basis(Vector3.UP, yaw), at), zone)
+
+	## A flat panel (a decal, a screen, a banner): its middle, half extents along `right` and `down`.
+	func panel(mid: Vector3, right: Vector3, down: Vector3, zone: int, facing: Vector3, g := 0.0) -> void:
+		var a := mid - right - down
+		var b := mid + right - down
+		var c := mid + right + down
+		var d := mid - right + down
+		var inner := mid - facing
+		tri(a, b, c, zone, inner, [Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(1, 0), Vector2(1, 1)], g)
+		tri(a, c, d, zone, inner, [Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(0, 1)], g)
+
+	## A disc (a roundel): UV across it 0..1.
+	func disc(mid: Vector3, normal: Vector3, up: Vector3, r: float, zone: int, seg := 32) -> void:
+		var right := up.cross(normal).normalized() * r
+		var u2 := normal.cross(right).normalized() * r
+		for i in seg:
+			var a0 := TAU * i / seg
+			var a1 := TAU * (i + 1) / seg
+			var p0 := mid + right * cos(a0) + u2 * sin(a0)
+			var p1 := mid + right * cos(a1) + u2 * sin(a1)
+			tri(mid, p0, p1, zone, mid - normal, [Vector2(0.5, 0.5), Vector2(0.5 + 0.5 * cos(a0), 0.5 - 0.5 * sin(a0)), Vector2(0.5 + 0.5 * cos(a1), 0.5 - 0.5 * sin(a1))])
+
+	## A cylinder between `a` and `b` (radii ra, rb), `caps` closed.
+	func cyl(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, ra: float, rb: float, zone: int, seg := 12, caps := true) -> void:
+		if a.distance_squared_to(b) < 1e-8:
+			return
+		var ax := (b - a).normalized()
+		var side := ax.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(ax.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+		var up := ax.cross(side)
+		for i in seg:
+			var a0 := TAU * i / seg
+			var a1 := TAU * (i + 1) / seg
+			var d0 := side * cos(a0) + up * sin(a0)
+			var d1 := side * cos(a1) + up * sin(a1)
+			quad(a + d0 * ra, a + d1 * ra, b + d1 * rb, b + d0 * rb, zone, (a + b) * 0.5)
+			if caps:
+				tri(a, a + d0 * ra, a + d1 * ra, zone, a + ax)
+				tri(b, b + d1 * rb, b + d0 * rb, zone, b - ax)
+
+	## A lathe round the z axis through (x, y): profile [[z, r, zone], ...] - its
+	## faces outward on the profile's right (going on in z, away from the axis;
+	## a step in at one z faces back, out faces forward).
+	func lathe(x: float, y: float, prof: Array, seg := 16) -> void:
+		for k in prof.size() - 1:
+			var p0: Array = prof[k]
+			var p1: Array = prof[k + 1]
+			var dz := float(p1[0]) - float(p0[0])
+			var dr := float(p1[1]) - float(p0[1])
+			var nz := -dr
+			var nr := dz
+			var c0 := Vector3(x, y, p0[0])
+			var c1 := Vector3(x, y, p1[0])
+			for i in seg:
+				var a0 := TAU * (i + 0.5) / seg
+				var a1 := TAU * (i + 1.5) / seg
+				var d0 := Vector3(cos(a0), sin(a0), 0)
+				var d1 := Vector3(cos(a1), sin(a1), 0)
+				var q := [c0 + d0 * p0[1], c0 + d1 * p0[1], c1 + d1 * p1[1], c1 + d0 * p1[1]]
+				var mid: Vector3 = (q[0] + q[1] + q[2] + q[3]) * 0.25
+				var dm := Vector3(cos(TAU * (i + 1.0) / seg), sin(TAU * (i + 1.0) / seg), 0)
+				var out := (dm * nr + Vector3(0, 0, nz)).normalized()
+				quad(q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3], int(p1[2]), mid - out * 0.1)
+
+	## An armoured loft through chamfered sections [z, half width, top, bottom, chamfer]:
+	## eight faces round (top, chamfers, sides, bottom), `zone_of.call(segment, face)`
+	## the zone of each (-1: left out - glass goes in another mesh). `cap_front` closes the first.
+	func loft(sections: Array, zone_of: Callable, cap_front := true, cap_back := true) -> void:
+		var rings: Array = []
+		for s in sections:
+			rings.append(ring(s))
+		for k in sections.size() - 1:
+			var inner := Vector3(0, (float(sections[k][2]) + float(sections[k][3])) * 0.5, (float(sections[k][0]) + float(sections[k + 1][0])) * 0.5)
+			for f in 8:
+				var z: int = zone_of.call(k, f)
+				if z < 0:
+					continue
+				var j: int = (f + 1) % 8
+				quad(rings[k][f], rings[k][j], rings[k + 1][j], rings[k + 1][f], z, inner)
+		for e in ([0] if cap_front else []) + ([sections.size() - 1] if cap_back else []):
+			var s: Array = sections[e]
+			var mid := Vector3(0, (float(s[2]) + float(s[3])) * 0.5, float(s[0]))
+			var out := Vector3(0, 0, -1.0 if e == 0 else 1.0)
+			for f in 8:
+				tri(mid, rings[e][f], rings[e][(f + 1) % 8], IRON if e > 0 else maxi(int(zone_of.call(0, 2)), 0), mid - out)
+
+	## The eight corners of a section (round from the top's left).
+	static func ring(s: Array) -> Array:
+		var z: float = s[0]
+		var w: float = s[1]
+		var t: float = s[2]
+		var b: float = s[3]
+		var c: float = minf(s[4], minf(w, (t - b) * 0.5) * 0.95)
+		return [Vector3(-w + c, t, z), Vector3(w - c, t, z), Vector3(w, t - c, z), Vector3(w, b + c, z),
+			Vector3(w - c, b, z), Vector3(-w + c, b, z), Vector3(-w, b + c, z), Vector3(-w, t - c, z)]
+
+	func commit() -> ArrayMesh:
+		return st.commit()
+
+	func arrays() -> Array:
+		return st.commit_to_arrays()
+
+
+## Faces of an armoured loft (`f`): 0 top, 1 upper right, 2 right, 3 lower right,
+## 4 bottom, 5 lower left, 6 left, 7 upper left.
+const TOP := 0
+const SIDES := [2, 6]
+const UPPER := [1, 7]
+const LOWER := [3, 5]
+
+
+## A section's numbers at `z` (between the two round it).
+static func section_at(sections: Array, z: float) -> Array:
+	for k in sections.size() - 1:
+		var a: Array = sections[k]
+		var b: Array = sections[k + 1]
+		if z >= float(a[0]) and z <= float(b[0]):
+			var t := (z - float(a[0])) / maxf(float(b[0]) - float(a[0]), 0.001)
+			return [z, lerpf(a[1], b[1], t), lerpf(a[2], b[2], t), lerpf(a[3], b[3], t), lerpf(a[4], b[4], t)]
+	return sections[0] if z < float(sections[0][0]) else sections[sections.size() - 1]
+
+
+## A crate of the Minoan stores: steel-cornered, cream or red, the triskelion on its sides.
+static func crate(m: Mesher, at: Vector3, size: Vector3, red := false, yaw := 0.0) -> void:
+	var b := Basis(Vector3.UP, yaw)
+	var xf := Transform3D(b, at + Vector3(0, size.y * 0.5, 0))
+	m.box(size, xf, RED if red else CREAM)
+	# (steel edges)
+	for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		for sz in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			m.box(Vector3(0.08, size.y + 0.02, 0.08), Transform3D(b, xf * Vector3(sx * size.x * 0.5, 0, sz * size.z * 0.5)), STEEL)
+	var r := minf(size.y, size.z) * 0.32
+	for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var nrm := b * Vector3(sx, 0, 0)
+		m.disc(xf * Vector3(sx * (size.x * 0.5 + 0.012), 0, 0), nrm, Vector3.UP, r, TRISKELION, 20)

files.explanation: New: your ship's hull, a Minoan armoured hauler about 58 m long, built as mesh data (on a worker) from MinoanKit parts: a loft of chamfered sections with the nose's top faces as glass (the bridge's windows) framed in steel ribs, raised armour plates, a spine with masts, amber lamps in rows, the triskelion on both flanks, vents, cargo pods under the belly, four lathed engine nacelles on pylons, and the tail plate round the loading door. The meshes are made once a run and shared: the Minoan NPC haulers place the same mesh scaled to their class.

@@ -1,0 +1,196 @@ 
+class_name MinoanShip
+extends RefCounted
+## Your ship, a Minoan armoured hauler (~58 m): a long hull of chamfered plates
+## (cream, worn, red bands), the bridge's windows wrapped over its nose, a
+## raised spine with masts, four engine nacelles at the back (two a side,
+## stacked), the triskelion on its flanks, amber lamps in rows along it, cargo
+## pods under the belly, the tail a door (the ramp: CosmosShipInterior). Built
+## as data (`build` - a worker's): one mesh, the glass apart.
+
+## The hull: [z, half width, top, bottom, chamfer] (ship space, metres, -z the nose).
+const HULL := [[-28.0, 1.8, 0.2, -1.2, 0.6], [-25.5, 4.8, 2.0, -2.4, 1.4], [-21.0, 6.8, 3.9, -3.0, 1.9],
+	[-12.0, 7.4, 4.5, -3.1, 1.6], [4.0, 7.6, 4.6, -3.2, 1.6], [16.0, 7.2, 4.4, -3.0, 1.6], [22.4, 6.2, 3.8, -2.8, 1.6]]
+const SPINE := [[-15.0, 1.0, 4.9, 3.8, 0.4], [-11.0, 3.2, 6.4, 3.8, 1.0], [9.0, 3.4, 6.6, 3.8, 1.0], [14.5, 2.4, 5.8, 3.8, 0.8]]
+## The nacelles' middles (x, y): two a side.
+const NACELLES := [Vector2(-10.1, -0.4), Vector2(10.1, -0.4), Vector2(-9.7, 5.0), Vector2(9.7, 5.0)]
+const NACELLE_R := 2.5
+const NOZZLE_Z := 29.2
+const LENGTH := 58.0                     # (nose to nozzles)
+static var _mesh: ArrayMesh
+static var _glass: ArrayMesh
+## The tail's door (x half width, y from, y to) - the inside's aft room.
+const DOOR := [3.4, -1.4, 2.0]
+
+
+static func build() -> Dictionary:
+	var m := MinoanKit.Mesher.new()
+	var g := MinoanKit.Mesher.new()
+	# The hull: the nose's top faces glass (the bridge's windows), bands of red.
+	var zone_of := func(seg: int, f: int) -> int:
+		if seg <= 1 and (f == MinoanKit.TOP or f in MinoanKit.UPPER):
+			return -1
+		if f == MinoanKit.TOP:
+			return MinoanKit.CREAM
+		if f in MinoanKit.UPPER:
+			return MinoanKit.RED if seg in [2, 4] else MinoanKit.CREAM
+		if f in MinoanKit.LOWER:
+			return MinoanKit.RED if seg == 1 else MinoanKit.CREAM
+		if f == 4:
+			return MinoanKit.IRON
+		return MinoanKit.RED if seg == 1 else MinoanKit.CREAM
+	m.loft(HULL, zone_of, true, false)
+	for seg in 2:
+		var r0 := MinoanKit.Mesher.ring(HULL[seg])
+		var r1 := MinoanKit.Mesher.ring(HULL[seg + 1])
+		var inner := Vector3(0, -0.5, (float(HULL[seg][0]) + float(HULL[seg + 1][0])) * 0.5)
+		for f in [7, 0, 1]:
+			var j: int = (f + 1) % 8
+			g.quad(r0[f], r0[j], r1[j], r1[f], 0, inner)
+		# (the windows' frames: steel ribs across and along)
+		for f in [7, 0, 1]:
+			m.cyl(r1[f], r1[(f + 1) % 8], 0.09, 0.09, MinoanKit.STEEL, 4, false)
+			if seg == 0:
+				m.cyl(r0[f], r0[(f + 1) % 8], 0.09, 0.09, MinoanKit.STEEL, 4, false)
+		for f in [7, 0, 1, 2]:
+			m.cyl(r0[f], r1[f], 0.09, 0.09, MinoanKit.STEEL, 4, false)
+	_plates(m)
+	_tail(m)
+	# The spine and its masts.
+	m.loft(SPINE, func(seg: int, f: int) -> int:
+		if f in MinoanKit.SIDES or f in MinoanKit.UPPER:
+			return MinoanKit.RED if seg == 1 and f in MinoanKit.SIDES else MinoanKit.CREAM
+		return MinoanKit.CREAM if f == MinoanKit.TOP else MinoanKit.IRON)
+	for mast in [[-3.0, 10.6, 0.12], [-1.2, 9.2, 0.1], [0.8, 8.4, 0.09], [6.0, 7.8, 0.15]]:
+		m.cyl(Vector3(0.6, 6.4, mast[0]), Vector3(0.6, mast[1], mast[0]), mast[2], mast[2] * 0.4, MinoanKit.STEEL, 6)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(2.2, 0.5, 4.0), Vector3(0, 6.7, 4.0), MinoanKit.IRON)
+	m.boxat(Vector3(1.4, 0.4, 2.0), Vector3(-1.0, 6.6, -6.0), MinoanKit.IRON)
+	for z in [-9.0, -4.0, 1.0, 6.0]:   # (the spine's lamps)
+		for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+			var s := MinoanKit.section_at(SPINE, z)
+			m.boxat(Vector3(0.08, 0.12, 2.6), Vector3(sx * (float(s[1]) + 0.02), 4.4, z), MinoanKit.LAMP)
+	# Plates on the flanks, the roundels, the lamps in rows.
+	for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
+		var rs := MinoanKit.section_at(HULL, 7.0)
+		m.disc(Vector3(sx * (float(rs[1]) + 0.17), 0.7, 7.0), Vector3(sx, 0, 0), Vector3.UP, 2.2, MinoanKit.TRISKELION, 40)
+		for z in range(-22, 20, 3):
+			if absf(z - 7.0) < 3.0:
+				continue
+			var s := MinoanKit.section_at(HULL, z)
+			var w: float = s[1]
+			var lo: float = float(s[3]) + float(s[4])
+			m.boxat(Vector3(0.2, 0.1, 1.6), Vector3(sx * (w + 0.08), lo + 0.25, z + 0.5), MinoanKit.LAMP)
+		for z in [-17.5, -15.5, -13.5]:   # (the bridge's side windows, lit)
+			var s := MinoanKit.section_at(HULL, z)

files.explanation: CosmosShip is the player's ship: its flight model, guns, landing and its hull. This patch gives it the throttle detent at zero and a named reverse limit, R / F thrusters in the comments, faster pulse bolts carried on the ship's speed, the mining beam firing before the guns, and replaces the old lofted hull with the Minoan hauler (MinoanShip), whose mesh data is built once on a worker.

files.explanation: The walkable inside of your ship, rebuilt in the Minoan look: a bigger bridge in the nose (the captain's throne on a lit dais, two crew seats at consoles under the windows, banners, plants, a star-map hologram), the quarters through an arch (bed, shelves, couch, table, rug), the loading bay (crane, hazard stripes, banners) and the aft door. All the static rooms are one mesh built on a worker (started from the title by CosmosWarm), in one Minoan material. The terminals moved onto the bridge and into the bay. The loading door is now hinged at the deck: it swings out and down into the ramp's first part, pushed by two rams, then a second section slides out to the ground. Cargo is shown as the stores' crates in one mesh.

files.explanation: New: the target's window, top left under the ship's gauge. When you lock a target (T) it shows it live in a SubViewport (380 x 210) that renders the same world from its own camera, circling the target from its star's lit side, and under it a card of stats chosen by the target's kind: a ship's or creature's shields, hull, speed and weapons; a planet's type, size, orbit and surface; a star's type and heat; a station's trade and free pads; a gate's destination; a town, a lair, an asteroid. To keep the frame rate it renders only while there is a target, 30 times a second, without lamp shadows, and it draws one frame under the loading veil so its buffers exist before flight.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,322 @@ 
+class_name CosmosTargetView
+extends Control
+## The target's window (top left, under the ship's gauge): what you've locked on
+## (T) seen live - a camera of its own circling it in the same world, lit from
+## its star's side - and its card under it: a ship's or a creature's shields and
+## hull, speed, weapons; a planet's or a star's kind, size, orbit; a station's
+## trade, pads, state. Rendered SHOW_HZ times a second, only while there's a
+## target (the main view's frame rate first).
+
+const W := 380.0
+const VIEW_H := 210.0
+const SHOW_HZ := 30.0
+const FOV := 30.0
+const FILL := 0.62              # (the target's share of the view's height)
+const SPIN := 0.22              # rad/s round it
+
+var cosmos: Node
+var _box: SubViewportContainer
+var _vp: SubViewport
+var _cam: Camera3D
+var _font: Font
+var _for: Node3D = null         # the target the camera's on
+var _spin := 0.0
+var _due := 0.0
+var _card := {}
+var _card_t := 0.0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_font = get_theme_default_font()
+	_box = SubViewportContainer.new()
+	_box.stretch = true
+	_box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	_box.position = Vector2(0, 40)
+	_box.size = Vector2(W, VIEW_H)
+	add_child(_box)
+	_vp = SubViewport.new()
+	_vp.size = Vector2i(int(W), int(VIEW_H))
+	_vp.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_2X
+	_vp.positional_shadow_atlas_size = 0   # (no lamps' shadows in it: the star's light only)
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+	_vp.audio_listener_enable_3d = false
+	_box.add_child(_vp)
+	_cam = Camera3D.new()
+	_cam.fov = FOV
+	_vp.add_child(_cam)
+	_cam.current = true
+	visible = false
+	# (one frame now, under the loading veil: its buffers made, its first draw's cost not paid mid-flight)
+	_cam.look_at_from_position(Vector3(0, 0, 50), Vector3.ZERO)
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+
+
+func _tgt() -> Node3D:
+	var raw: Variant = cosmos.target if cosmos else null
+	if raw == null or not is_instance_valid(raw):
+		return null
+	if not cosmos.hud.visible or cosmos.docked or cosmos.dungeon != null or (cosmos.walker and cosmos.walker.get("deck") != null):
+		return null   # (in a hangar, a cave, aboard: no window)
+	return raw
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	var t := _tgt()
+	if t == null:
+		if visible:
+			visible = false
+			_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+			_for = null
+		return
+	if t != _for:
+		_for = t
+		_spin = 0.0
+		_due = 0.0
+		_card_t = 0.0
+	visible = true
+	_place()
+	_spin += delta * SPIN
+	_due -= delta
+	if _due <= 0.0:
+		_due = 1.0 / SHOW_HZ
+		_aim(t)
+		_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+	_card_t -= delta
+	if _card_t <= 0.0:
+		_card_t = 0.1
+		_card = card(t)
+		queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Under the gauge (the 2D HUD's, top left), the guns' line above it.
+func _place() -> void:
+	var g: Control = cosmos.hud2d.gauge if cosmos.get("hud2d") and cosmos.hud2d.gauge else null
+	var gr := g.get_global_rect() if g else Rect2(80, 60, 180, 180)
+	position = Vector2(maxf(16.0, gr.position.x - 40.0), gr.end.y + 66.0)
+
+
+## How big it is (m, from its middle): the camera stands back to fit it.
+func _size_of(t: Node3D) -> float:
+	if t is CosmosPlanet:
+		return maxf(t.radius, t.atmo_radius) * 1.02
+	if t is CosmosStar:
+		return t.radius * 1.15
+	if t is CosmosStation:
+		return t.reach * 0.55
+	if t is CosmosGate:
+		return CosmosGate.RADIUS * 1.2
+	if t is CosmosMonster:
+		return t.length * 0.45
+	if t is CosmosNpcShip:
+		return t.reach * 0.55
+	if t is CosmosShip:
+		return t.reach * 0.5
+	if t is CosmosTown:
+		return float(t.site["r"]) * 1.1
+	if t is CosmosLair:
+		return 400.0
+	if t.has_meta("rock_radius"):
+		return float(t.get_meta("rock_radius")) * 1.2
+	return 50.0
+
+
+## The camera: round the target (its own up for a ship), from the side its
+## star lights - a planet seen part day, part night.
+func _aim(t: Node3D) -> void:
+	var at := t.global_position
+	var s := _size_of(t)
+	var dist := s / tan(deg_to_rad(FOV * 0.5 * FILL))
+	var sun := Vector3.UP
+	if cosmos.star and t != cosmos.star:
+		sun = (cosmos.star.global_position - at).normalized()
+	var up := Vector3.UP
+	var dir: Vector3
+	if t is CosmosStar:
+		dir = Vector3(sin(_spin), 0.7, cos(_spin)).normalized()   # (from above the planets' plane: nothing between)
+	elif t is CosmosTown:
+		up = (at - t.planet.global_position).normalized()   # (a town from above, its planet's sky behind)
+		var side := up.cross(sun)
+		if side.length() < 0.01:
+			side = up.cross(Vector3.RIGHT)
+		dir = (up + side.normalized() * 0.9).normalized().rotated(up, _spin)
+	elif t is CosmosGate:
+		dir = t.global_basis.orthonormalized() * Vector3(sin(_spin) * 0.6, 0.25, 1.0).normalized()   # (through its ring, a little aside)
+	elif t is CosmosPlanet or t is CosmosLair:
+		dir = sun.rotated(Vector3.UP, 0.75 + sin(_spin) * 0.35)
+		dir = (dir + Vector3.UP * 0.25).normalized()
+	else:
+		var b := t.global_basis.orthonormalized()
+		up = b.y
+		var orb := b * Vector3(sin(_spin + 0.8), 0.32, cos(_spin + 0.8)).normalized()
+		dir = (orb + sun * 0.45).normalized()
+	if absf(dir.dot(up)) > 0.98:
+		up = dir.cross(Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	var from := at + dir * dist
+	_cam.near = clampf((dist - s * 1.6) * 0.5, 0.05, 1000.0)
+	_cam.far = dist + s * 4.0 + 2000.0
+	_cam.look_at_from_position(from, at, up)
+
+
+# --- The card ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## What it says of `t`: {title, sub, col, bars: [[label, value, max, colour]], rows: [[key, value]]}.
+func card(t: Node3D) -> Dictionary:
+	var acc := NeonTheme.CYAN
+	var warn := Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.3)
+	var d: float = cosmos.cam.global_position.distance_to(t.global_position) - cosmos.radius_of(t) if cosmos.cam else 0.0
+	var c := {"title": cosmos.label_of(t), "sub": CosmosHud._dist(d), "col": acc, "bars": [], "rows": []}
+	var spd: float = cosmos.ship.speed() if cosmos.ship and cosmos.walker == null else 0.0
+	if spd > 5.0:
+		c["sub"] += "  -  %s away" % CosmosHud._time(d / spd)
+	var rows: Array = c["rows"]
+	var shield := Color(0.6, 0.9, 1.0)
+	var hull := Color(1.0, 0.65, 0.3)
+	if t is CosmosNpcShip:
+		var empire := Galaxy.empire_name(t.faction) if t.kind != "pirate" else "Pirates"
+		c["col"] = warn if t.hostile else acc
+		c["bars"] = [["SHIELDS", t.shield, t.max_shield, shield], ["HULL", t.hull, t.max_hull, hull]]
+		rows.append(["Class", "%s - %d m" % [str(t.hull_kind).capitalize(), roundi(t.reach * 2.0)]])
+		rows.append(["Flag", empire])
+		rows.append(["Stance", ("Fleeing" if t.kind == "trader" else "Hostile") if t.hostile else "Neutral"])
+		rows.append(["Speed", "%s  (top %s)" % [CosmosHud._speed(t.velocity.length()), CosmosHud._speed(t.speed_max)]])
+		rows.append(["Weapons", "Unarmed" if t.kind == "trader" else "Laser cannon - %d dmg, %.1f/s" % [roundi(CosmosNpcShip.LASER_DAMAGE), 1.0 / CosmosNpcShip.LASER_EVERY]])
+		if t.kind == "trader" and is_instance_valid(t.dest):
+			rows.append(["Bound for", cosmos.label_of(t.dest)])
+	elif t is CosmosMonster:
+		c["col"] = warn
+		c["bars"] = [["SHIELDS", t.shield, t.max_shield, shield], ["HIDE", t.hull, t.max_hull, hull]] if t.max_shield > 0.0 else [["HIDE", t.hull, t.max_hull, hull]]
+		rows.append(["Kind", "Space creature - %d m long" % roundi(t.length)])
+		rows.append(["Threat", "Level x%.1f" % t.mult])
+		rows.append(["Speed", CosmosHud._speed(t.velocity.length())])
+		rows.append(["Attacks", "Orbs %d dmg, ram %d" % [roundi(t.damage), roundi(t.damage * 3.0)]])
+	elif t is CosmosShip:
+		c["bars"] = [["SHIELDS", t.shield, t.max_shield, shield], ["HULL", t.hull, t.max_hull, hull]]
+		rows.append(["State", {"landed": "Landed", "fly": "In flight"}.get(t.state, str(t.state).capitalize())])
+		var names: Array = []
+		for g in t.guns:
+			names.append(g["name"])
+		rows.append(["Weapons", ", ".join(names) if not names.is_empty() else "None"])
+	elif t is CosmosPlanet:
+		var type := str(t.rec.get("type", ""))
+		var info: Dictionary = Planets.TYPES.get(type, {})
+		rows.append(["Type", str(info.get("label", type.capitalize())).capitalize()])
+		rows.append(["Radius", "%s  (%s across)" % [CosmosHud._dist(t.radius), CosmosHud._dist(t.radius * 2.0)]])
+		var moon_of := str(t.rec.get("moon_of", ""))
+		var orbit := float(t.rec.get("orbit", 0.0))
+		if orbit > 0.0:
+			var period := (240.0 if moon_of != "" else 900.0 * pow(orbit / 3000.0, 1.5)) * Cosmos.ORBIT_SLOWDOWN
+			var round_what := "the star"
+			if moon_of != "":
+				var parent: Dictionary = Galaxy.planet_record(moon_of)
+				round_what = str(parent.get("name", Planets.PLANETS.get(moon_of, {}).get("name", "its planet")))
+			rows.append(["Orbit", "%s round %s" % [CosmosHud._dist(orbit * PlanetShape.PX_TO_M), round_what]])
+			rows.append(["Year", CosmosHud._time(period)])
+		var moons := 0
+		for p in cosmos.planets:
+			if str(p.rec.get("moon_of", "")) == str(t.rec.get("id", "-")):
+				moons += 1
+		if moon_of == "":
+			rows.append(["Moons", str(moons) if moons > 0 else "None"])
+		var sh: PlanetShape = t.shape
+		if sh.kind == "gas":
+			rows.append(["Surface", "None - clouds all the way down"])
+		else:
+			rows.append(["Surface", ["Dry ground", "Seas", "Ice sheets", "Lava seas"][clampi(sh.sea, 0, 3)] + ", relief %s" % CosmosHud._dist(sh.amp * 3.0)])
+		rows.append(["Air", "Atmosphere" if t.atmo_radius > t.radius else "None"])
+		if not t.towns.is_empty():
+			rows.append(["Towns", str(t.towns.size())])
+	elif t is CosmosStar:
+		var sys: Dictionary = Galaxy.system(cosmos.system_id)
+		var kind: Dictionary = Galaxy.STARS.get(str(sys.get("star", "yellow")), Galaxy.STARS["yellow"])
+		rows.append(["Type", str(kind["name"])])
+		rows.append(["Radius", "%s  (%s across)" % [CosmosHud._dist(t.radius), CosmosHud._dist(t.radius * 2.0)]])
+		rows.append(["Planets", str(cosmos.planets.filter(func(p): return str(p.rec.get("moon_of", "")) == "").size())])
+		rows.append(["Heat", "Burns shields within %s" % CosmosHud._dist(t.radius * (Cosmos.HEAT_FROM - 1.0))])
+		rows.append(["Rule", Galaxy.empire_name(str(sys.get("owner", "")))])
+	elif t is CosmosStation:
+		var r: Dictionary = t.record
+		var econ: Dictionary = Galaxy.ECONOMIES.get(str(r.get("economy", "")), {})
+		c["bars"] = [["STATE", float(r.get("health", 100.0)), 100.0, hull]]
+		rows.append(["Kind", str(econ.get("name", "Station"))])
+		rows.append(["Flag", Galaxy.empire_name(str(r.get("empire", "")))])
+		rows.append(["Sells", _goods(econ.get("produce", {}))])
+		rows.append(["Buys", _goods(econ.get("consume", {}))])
+		var free := 0
+		for p in t.pads:
+			if p.get("owner") == null or not is_instance_valid(p.get("owner")):
+				free += 1
+		rows.append(["Pads", "%d of %d free" % [free, t.pads.size()]])
+	elif t is CosmosGate:
+		var sys: Dictionary = Galaxy.system(t.to)
+		rows.append(["Leads to", "%s system" % str(sys.get("name", t.to))])
+		rows.append(["Rule", Galaxy.empire_name(str(sys.get("owner", "")))])
+		rows.append(["Star", str(Galaxy.STARS.get(str(sys.get("star", "yellow")), {}).get("name", ""))])
+		rows.append(["Ring", "%s across" % CosmosHud._dist(CosmosGate.RADIUS * 2.0)])
+	elif t is CosmosTown:
+		rows.append(["Kind", "City" if str(t.site["kind"]) == "city" else "Village"])
+		if is_instance_valid(t.planet):
+			rows.append(["On", cosmos.label_of(t.planet)])
+		rows.append(["Size", "%s across" % CosmosHud._dist(float(t.site["r"]) * 2.0)])
+	elif t is CosmosLair:
+		c["col"] = warn
+		rows.append(["Signal", str(SignalSites.level_info(t.sig).get("name", ""))])
+		rows.append(["Reading", "A living thing - large"])
+	elif t.has_meta("rock_radius"):
+		var st: Dictionary = cosmos.mining.rock_state() if cosmos.mining else {}
+		rows.append(["Kind", "Asteroid - %s" % (cosmos.mining.field.kind.capitalize() if cosmos.mining and cosmos.mining.field else "rock")])
+		rows.append(["Radius", CosmosHud._dist(float(t.get_meta("rock_radius")))])
+		if not st.is_empty():
+			rows.append(["Holds", cosmos.mining.comp_text() if st["scanned"] else "Not scanned"])
+			c["bars"] = [["ORE", float(st["ore_left"]), float(maxi(int(st["ore_total"]), 1)), hull]]
+	return c
+
+
+func _goods(m: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var ks: Array = m.keys()
+	ks.sort_custom(func(a, b): return m[a] > m[b])
+	var out: Array = []
+	for k in ks.slice(0, 3):
+		out.append(str(Items.ITEMS.get(k, {}).get("name", str(k).capitalize())))
+	return ", ".join(out) if not out.is_empty() else "-"
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if _card.is_empty():
+		return
+	var col: Color = _card["col"]
+	var rows: Array = _card["rows"]
+	var bars: Array = _card["bars"]
+	var h := 40.0 + VIEW_H + 12.0 + bars.size() * 20.0 + rows.size() * 22.0 + 6.0
+	draw_style_box(NeonTheme.box(Color(col, 0.8), Color(NeonTheme.BG, 0.72), 2, 6), Rect2(-8, -6, W + 16, h + 6))
+	_text(Vector2(0, 18), str(_card["title"]), 20, col)
+	_text(Vector2(0, 34), str(_card["sub"]), 15, Color(NeonTheme.TEXT_DIM, 0.95))
+	draw_rect(Rect2(-1, 39, W + 2, VIEW_H + 2), Color(col, 0.5), false, 1.0)
+	# (corner ticks on the view: a sight)
+	var vr := Rect2(0, 40, W, VIEW_H)
+	var k := 14.0
+	for cn in [vr.position, Vector2(vr.end.x, vr.position.y), vr.end, Vector2(vr.position.x, vr.end.y)]:
+		var sx := 1.0 if cn.x < vr.get_center().x else -1.0
+		var sy := 1.0 if cn.y < vr.get_center().y else -1.0
+		draw_line(cn, cn + Vector2(k * sx, 0), col, 2.0)
+		draw_line(cn, cn + Vector2(0, k * sy), col, 2.0)
+	var y := 40.0 + VIEW_H + 16.0
+	for b in bars:
+		var bc: Color = b[3]
+		var frac := clampf(float(b[1]) / maxf(float(b[2]), 0.001), 0.0, 1.0)
+		_text(Vector2(0, y + 5), str(b[0]), 14, Color(NeonTheme.TEXT_DIM, 0.95))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(80, y - 4, W - 150, 8), Color(bc, 0.25))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(80, y - 4, (W - 150) * frac, 8), bc)
+		_text(Vector2(W - 62, y + 5), "%d/%d" % [roundi(float(b[1])), roundi(float(b[2]))], 14, bc)
+		y += 20.0
+	y += 4.0
+	for r in rows:
+		_text(Vector2(0, y + 6), str(r[0]), 16, Color(NeonTheme.TEXT_DIM, 0.95))
+		_text(Vector2(92, y + 6), str(r[1]), 16, NeonTheme.TEXT)
+		y += 22.0
+
+
+func _text(at: Vector2, s: String, fs: int, c: Color) -> void:
+	var w := W - at.x
+	draw_string_outline(_font, at, s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, w, fs, 4, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.7))
+	draw_string(_font, at, s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, w, fs, c)

hunks.note: A Control on the HUD layer holding a SubViewportContainer and a SubViewport with its own Camera3D. _process finds the target, re-aims the camera and asks for one viewport frame every 1/SHOW_HZ s, and rebuilds the stats card 10 times a second; _draw draws the frame, the corner ticks, the bars and the rows.

bubbles.text: The viewport doesn't render by itself; _process asks for single frames (UPDATE_ONCE) on a timer.
No omni/spot shadows in the small view: only the star's light, which keeps its cost low.
No window when the HUD is hidden, docked, in a cave or aboard the ship.
One render per tick at SHOW_HZ (30/s), so the main view keeps its frame rate.
How big each kind of target is, so the camera can stand back and fit it to FILL (62%) of the view's height.
The camera distance that makes the target fill that share of the view.
The stats for each kind of target: {title, sub, col, bars, rows}. Built 10 times a second, not every frame.

bubbles.at: var period := (240.0 if moon_of != "" else 900.0 * pow(orbit / 3000.0, 1.5)) * Cosmos.ORBIT_SLOWDOWN
bubbles.text: A planet's year from its orbit radius (Kepler's 3/2 power), matching how Cosmos moves the planets.

files.explanation: The character on foot. Three changes: a shoulder lamp (a spot light, no shadows) that fades in down in dug ground or at night and shines where the camera looks; the floor in dug ground from PlanetShape.floor_below (into pits, along tunnels); and firing goes to CosmosDeposits first, so the mining beam or the terrain digger takes the trigger instead of the rifle.

+## The lamp: on (faded in) down in dug ground - a pit, a tunnel, under the
+## ground as it was - or where the sun's down; it shines where the camera looks.
+var lamp: SpotLight3D
+var lamp_on := false
+var _lamp_t := 0.0
+const LAMP_ENERGY := 2.6
+
+
+func _lamp_step(delta: float) -> void:

files.explanation: Cosmos is the 3D scene's root: it builds the system, runs the floating origin, picks targets, keeps the camera and the walker out of solid things and runs docking. This patch wires in the new systems: the asteroid mining beam (CosmosMining) and the on-foot deposits and digger (CosmosDeposits), the target's window (CosmosTargetView), dug ground for the camera and the walker, the sky's ambient light by day, the planet quadtree visit carried on over several frames, the pad shafts' shutters during docking, L asking a station for a pad, and the new pulse bolt speed in the lead marker. The ship's hull and rooms now start building on workers when the scene starts.

files.explanation: New: mining on foot and the terrain digger. Deposits of the planet's minerals (crystal clusters or ore boulders, which minerals by the kind of world - MIX) stand one at most per 40 m grid cell, seeded so they're the same every visit, found on a worker within 130 m as you walk. Two shared meshes and one material, each mineral's look as instance uniforms. Fire at one within 30 m and the beam cuts 3 units a second into your pack; it shrinks and, mined out, is gone for good (CosmosGame.extra "dug"). The beam heats and overheats. V switches to the terrain digger: it carves a 2 m sphere where the sights meet the ground every 0.15 s (PlanetShape.dig, CosmosPlanet.redig).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,515 @@ 
+class_name CosmosDeposits
+extends Node3D
+## Mineral deposits on a planet's ground and mining them on foot (Cosmos): round
+## you as you walk, outcrops of the planet's minerals stand on the ground -
+## crystal clusters (ice, salt, sulphur, obsidian, orichalcum) and boulders
+## veined with ore (iron, copper, tin, silver, gold, cobalt, titanium,
+## platinum) - which minerals by the kind of world (MIX). Each from its own
+## cell of a grid over the planet (seeded: the same ones in the same places
+## every visit), found on a worker as you move.
+##
+## Fire with your sights on one within RANGE and your mining beam cuts it
+## instead of the rifle: ore comes off into your pack (the mineral itself),
+## the deposit shrinks and at the last unit breaks up and is gone - for good
+## (CosmosGame.extra "dug"). The beam heats as it cuts (harder minerals
+## faster); at the top it overheats and stops until it's cooled right down.
+##
+## The terrain digger (V switches the rifle for it): fire and the beam carves
+## the ground where your sights are - a sphere out of it each DIG_EVERY s
+## (PlanetShape.dig; drawn by the planet's voxels - CosmosPlanet.redig): held
+## on one spot it bores in along the beam, swept it cuts a trench; tunnels,
+## overhangs. Plants and boulders in it go. Not in a town. It heats the beam too.
+
+const CELL := 40.0              # m: one deposit at most a cell
+const NEAR := 130.0             # m: the deposits kept round you
+const MOVE := 18.0              # m: walked this far, the set's looked over again
+const CHANCE := 0.55            # a cell's chance of one (its point must land in it too)
+const RANGE := 30.0             # m: the beam's reach
+const RATE := 3.0               # units a second
+const HEAT := 0.22              # a second, at hardness 1
+const COOL := 0.35
+const UNITS_PER_M := 14.0       # units a metre of size
+const DIG_R := 2.0              # m: a carve's sphere (held on one spot, each goes 0.4 of it further in)
+const DIG_EVERY := 0.15         # s
+const DIG_MOST := 30.0          # m: the deepest under the ground a carve goes
+const DIG_HEAT := 0.13          # a second
+
+## The kinds of world -> {mineral: weight}.
+const MIX := {
+	"glacier": {"ice": 4, "salt": 2.5, "silver_ore": 2, "cobalt": 1.5},
+	"inferno": {"sulphur": 3.5, "obsidian": 3, "iron_ore": 2, "gold_ore": 1.5},
+	"ocean": {"copper_ore": 3, "salt": 2.5, "iron_ore": 2.5, "tin_ore": 2},
+	"alien": {"copper_ore": 2.5, "iron_ore": 2.5, "silver_ore": 2, "tin_ore": 1.5, "orichalcum": 0.8},
+	"barren": {"iron_ore": 3.5, "titanium_ore": 3, "cobalt": 2, "platinum_ore": 1.5},
+	"moon": {"iron_ore": 3, "titanium_ore": 3, "platinum_ore": 1.5, "ice": 1.5},
+	"": {"iron_ore": 4, "copper_ore": 3, "tin_ore": 3},
+}
+## A mineral's look: tint, metallic, glow, crystal (else an ore boulder).
+const LOOK := {
+	"ice": [Color(0.72, 0.88, 1.0), 0.0, 0.08, true], "salt": [Color(0.93, 0.9, 0.85), 0.0, 0.0, true],
+	"sulphur": [Color(0.95, 0.82, 0.18), 0.0, 0.05, true], "obsidian": [Color(0.07, 0.065, 0.09), 0.2, 0.0, true],
+	"orichalcum": [Color(1.0, 0.52, 0.22), 0.9, 0.25, true],
+	"iron_ore": [Color(0.55, 0.27, 0.16), 0.6, 0.0, false], "copper_ore": [Color(0.3, 0.62, 0.5), 0.4, 0.0, false],
+	"tin_ore": [Color(0.72, 0.73, 0.72), 0.9, 0.0, false], "silver_ore": [Color(0.86, 0.87, 0.9), 1.0, 0.0, false],
+	"gold_ore": [Color(1.0, 0.76, 0.3), 1.0, 0.03, false], "cobalt": [Color(0.22, 0.34, 0.85), 0.7, 0.04, false],
+	"titanium_ore": [Color(0.62, 0.64, 0.68), 0.9, 0.0, false], "platinum_ore": [Color(0.86, 0.85, 0.8), 1.0, 0.0, false],
+}
+
+static var _meshes: Array = []   # [crystal cluster, ore boulder]
+static var _mat: ShaderMaterial
+
+var cosmos: Node
+var planet: CosmosPlanet
+var deps := {}                  # cell key -> {key, node, at (planet-local), up, size, mineral, units, max}
+var focus: Dictionary = {}      # the deposit under the sights (in reach), or {}
+var heat := 0.0                 # the beam's: 0 .. 1
+var overheated := false
+var active := false             # the beam on (this frame)
+var got := {}                   # mineral -> units cut (this walk; the HUD's)
+var _acc := 0.0
+var _at := Vector3(INF, INF, INF)   # (planet-local: where the set was last looked over)
+var _task := -1
+var _found: Array = []
+var _beam: MeshInstance3D
+var _flare: MeshInstance3D
+var _t := 0.0
+var _check := 0.0
+var digger := false             # the terrain digger out (else the rifle)
+var dig_at := Vector3.ZERO      # (where it cuts, global; ZERO: nowhere in reach)
+var digs := 0                   # (cuts made: tests, the HUD)
+var _dig_t := 0.0
+
+
+## The shared meshes: a crystal cluster (hexagonal prisms with pointed tips,
+## leaning out of a stub of rock) and an ore boulder (a lumpy sphere), unit
+## sized, the crystal parts marked in the vertex colour (red = 1).
+static func meshes() -> Array:
+	if not _meshes.is_empty():
+		return _meshes
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+	rng.seed = 4242
+	_lump(st, Vector3(0, 0.1, 0), Vector3(0.75, 0.35, 0.7), 11, 0.0)
+	for k in 9:
+		var lean := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.55, 0.55), 1.0, rng.randf_range(-0.55, 0.55)).normalized()
+		if k == 0:
+			lean = Vector3(0.05, 1, 0.08).normalized()
+		var base := Vector3(rng.randf_range(-0.4, 0.4), 0.15, rng.randf_range(-0.4, 0.4)) * (0.3 if k == 0 else 1.0)
+		var len := rng.randf_range(0.5, 0.95) * (1.6 if k == 0 else 1.0)
+		_prism(st, base, lean, len, rng.randf_range(0.09, 0.16) * (1.5 if k == 0 else 1.0), rng.randf() * TAU)
+	st.generate_normals()
+	_meshes.append(st.commit())
+	st = SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	_lump(st, Vector3(0, 0.38, 0), Vector3(0.75, 0.5, 0.65), 77, 0.0)
+	_lump(st, Vector3(0.45, 0.2, 0.25), Vector3(0.35, 0.28, 0.32), 78, 0.0)
+	st.generate_normals()
+	_meshes.append(st.commit())
+	_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	_mat.shader = preload("res://shaders/world/deposit.gdshader")
+	return _meshes
+
+
+## A hexagonal crystal: six sides from `base` along `dir`, `len` long, a point on top.
+static func _prism(st: SurfaceTool, base: Vector3, dir: Vector3, len: float, r: float, turn: float) -> void:
+	var x := dir.cross(Vector3.FORWARD if absf(dir.z) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized().rotated(dir, turn)
+	var z := dir.cross(x)
+	var top := base + dir * len
+	var tip := top + dir * r * 2.2
+	st.set_color(Color(1, 0, 0))
+	for k in 6:
+		var a0 := TAU * k / 6.0
+		var a1 := TAU * (k + 1) / 6.0
+		var o0 := (x * cos(a0) + z * sin(a0)) * r
+		var o1 := (x * cos(a1) + z * sin(a1)) * r
+		for v in [base + o0, top + o0, top + o1, base + o0, top + o1, base + o1, top + o0, tip, top + o1]:
+			st.add_vertex(v)
+
+
+## A lump of rock: a sphere pushed about by noise, at `c` with radii `s`.
+static func _lump(st: SurfaceTool, c: Vector3, s: Vector3, seed: int, crystal: float) -> void:
+	var n := FastNoiseLite.new()
+	n.seed = seed
+	n.frequency = 1.1
+	var segs := 14
+	var rings := 8
+	st.set_color(Color(crystal, 0, 0))
+	var pt := func(r: int, g: int) -> Vector3:
+		var th := PI * r / rings
+		var ph := TAU * g / segs
+		var d := Vector3(sin(th) * cos(ph), cos(th), sin(th) * sin(ph))
+		return c + d * (1.0 + n.get_noise_3dv(d * 1.4) * 0.35) * s
+	for r in rings:
+		for g in segs:
+			var a: Vector3 = pt.call(r, g)
+			var b: Vector3 = pt.call(r, g + 1)
+			var cc: Vector3 = pt.call(r + 1, g)
+			var d: Vector3 = pt.call(r + 1, g + 1)
+			for v in [a, b, cc, b, d, cc]:
+				st.add_vertex(v)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "Deposits"
+	meshes()
+	if cosmos and cosmos.get("noise"):
+		_mat.set_shader_parameter("noise_tex", cosmos.noise)
+	var bm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	bm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
+	bm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
+	bm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
+	bm.albedo_color = Color(0.55, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
+	_beam = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	var cyl := CylinderMesh.new()
+	cyl.top_radius = 0.085
+	cyl.bottom_radius = 0.085
+	cyl.height = 1.0
+	cyl.radial_segments = 6
+	cyl.rings = 1
+	_beam.mesh = cyl
+	_beam.material_override = bm
+	_beam.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_beam.visible = false
+	add_child(_beam)
+	_flare = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	var sp := SphereMesh.new()
+	sp.radius = 0.25
+	sp.height = 0.5
+	sp.radial_segments = 8
+	sp.rings = 4
+	_flare.mesh = sp
+	_flare.material_override = bm
+	_flare.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_flare.visible = false
+	add_child(_flare)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _task != -1:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker if cosmos else null
+	if w == null or planet == null or w.get("planet") != planet:
+		return
+	# The set round you: looked over on a worker when you've moved (paced by time).
+	_check -= delta
+	var local: Vector3 = w.global_position - planet.global_position
+	if _task != -1 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task):
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		_place(_found, local)
+	elif _task == -1 and _check <= 0.0 and local.distance_to(_at) > MOVE:
+		_check = 0.4
+		_at = local
+		var dug: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("dug", {}).get(_pid(), {})
+		var out := []
+		_found = out
+		var shape: PlanetShape = planet.shape
+		var r: float = planet.radius
+		var sd := int(shape.look.get("seed", 0.0) * 1000.0)
+		var mix: Dictionary = MIX.get(str(planet.rec.get("type", "")), MIX[""])
+		_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): out.append_array(_find(shape, r, sd, mix, local, dug.duplicate())), true, "deposits")
+
+
+func _pid() -> String:
+	return str(planet.rec.get("id", planet.name))
+
+
+## (Worker) The deposits within NEAR of `local`: [key, at, up, size, mineral, units left share].
+static func _find(shape: PlanetShape, radius: float, sd: int, mix: Dictionary, local: Vector3, dug: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var c0 := (local / CELL).floor()
+	var n := int(ceil(NEAR / CELL))
+	var total := 0.0
+	for m in mix:
+		total += float(mix[m])
+	for x in range(-n, n + 1):
+		for y in range(-n, n + 1):
+			for z in range(-n, n + 1):
+				var cell := c0 + Vector3(x, y, z)
+				var cc := (cell + Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * CELL
+				if absf(cc.length() - radius) > CELL * 1.8 or cc.distance_to(local) > NEAR + CELL:
+					continue
+				var key := "%d,%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y, cell.z]
+				var left := float(dug.get(key, 1.0))
+				if left <= 0.0:
+					continue
+				var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+				rng.seed = hash([sd, key])
+				if rng.randf() > CHANCE:
+					continue
+				var d := ((cell + Vector3(rng.randf(), rng.randf(), rng.randf())) * CELL).normalized()
+				var h := shape.height(d)
+				var at := d * (radius + h)
+				if (at / CELL).floor() != cell or at.distance_to(local) > NEAR:
+					continue   # (its ground in another cell: that cell's)
+				if (shape.sea > 0 and h < 0.4) or shape.cleared(d):
+					continue
+				var pick := rng.randf() * total
+				var mineral: String = mix.keys()[0]
+				for mm in mix:
+					pick -= float(mix[mm])
+					if pick <= 0.0:
+						mineral = mm
+						break
+				var size := rng.randf_range(0.9, 2.2) * (1.4 if rng.randf() < 0.15 else 1.0)
+				out.append([key, at, d, size, mineral, left, rng.randf() * TAU])
+	return out
+
+
+## The set found: new ones made, the far ones dropped.
+func _place(found: Array, local: Vector3) -> void:
+	var keep := {}
+	for f in found:
+		keep[f[0]] = true
+		if deps.has(f[0]):
+			continue
+		var look: Array = LOOK.get(f[4], LOOK["iron_ore"])
+		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		mi.mesh = _meshes[0 if look[3] else 1]
+		mi.material_override = _mat
+		mi.visibility_range_end = 110.0   # (beyond, a deposit's a speck: not drawn)
+		add_child(mi)
+		mi.set_instance_shader_parameter("tint", look[0])
+		mi.set_instance_shader_parameter("metal", look[1])
+		mi.set_instance_shader_parameter("glow", look[2])
+		var up: Vector3 = f[2]
+		var x := up.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(up.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized().rotated(up, float(f[6]))
+		var units := int(float(f[3]) * UNITS_PER_M)
+		var dep := {"key": f[0], "node": mi, "at": f[1], "up": up, "size": float(f[3]), "basis": Basis(x, up, x.cross(up)),
+			"mineral": f[4], "max": units, "units": maxi(1, int(units * float(f[5])))}
+		deps[f[0]] = dep
+		_shape_of(dep)
+	for k in deps.keys():
+		if not keep.has(k) and (deps[k]["at"] as Vector3).distance_to(local) > NEAR + 30.0:
+			(deps[k]["node"] as Node).queue_free()
+			deps.erase(k)
+
+
+## A deposit's size by what's left of it (planet-local; this node rides the planet).
+func _shape_of(dep: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var left := float(dep["units"]) / maxf(1.0, float(dep["max"]))
+	var s := float(dep["size"]) * (0.3 + 0.7 * sqrt(left))
+	(dep["node"] as Node3D).transform = Transform3D((dep["basis"] as Basis).scaled(Vector3.ONE * s), (dep["at"] as Vector3) - (dep["up"] as Vector3) * 0.12 * s)
+
+
+## Its middle and radius (global): what the sights and your feet meet.
+func _sphere(dep: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var left := float(dep["units"]) / maxf(1.0, float(dep["max"]))
+	var s := float(dep["size"]) * (0.3 + 0.7 * sqrt(left))
+	return [planet.global_position + (dep["at"] as Vector3) + (dep["up"] as Vector3) * s * 0.45, s * 0.7]
+
+
+## The deposit a line from `o` along `dir` meets first within `reach`: [dep, distance] or [].
+func under(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, reach: float) -> Array:
+	var best: Array = []
+	var bt := reach
+	for k in deps:
+		var sp := _sphere(deps[k])
+		var oc: Vector3 = o - sp[0]
+		var b := oc.dot(dir)
+		var disc := b * b - (oc.dot(oc) - float(sp[1]) * float(sp[1]))
+		if disc < 0.0:
+			continue
+		var t := -b - sqrt(disc)
+		if t > 0.0 and t < bt:
+			bt = t
+			best = [deps[k], t]
+	return best
+
+
+## The walker kept out of the deposits (their middles: you step round them).
+func push(w: Node3D) -> void:
+	var u: Vector3 = w.up()
+	for k in deps:
+		var sp := _sphere(deps[k])
+		var d: Vector3 = w.global_position - sp[0]
+		var flat := d - u * d.dot(u)
+		var need := float(sp[1]) * 0.8 + CosmosWalker.BODY_R
+		if flat.length() < need and flat.length() > 0.001 and d.dot(u) < float(sp[1]):
+			w.global_position += flat.normalized() * (need - flat.length())
+
+
+## Every frame on foot: the beam, if you're firing at a deposit in reach -
+## true while it mines (the rifle holds its fire).
+func step(delta: float, firing: bool) -> bool:
+	active = false
+	if not overheated:
+		heat = maxf(0.0, heat - COOL * delta * (0.0 if firing else 1.0))
+	else:
+		heat = maxf(0.0, heat - COOL * 1.4 * delta)
+		if heat <= 0.0:
+			overheated = false
+	var cam: Camera3D = cosmos.cam
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	focus = {}
+	var h := under(cam.global_position, -cam.global_basis.z, RANGE + cam.global_position.distance_to(w.global_position))
+	if not h.is_empty() and (_sphere(h[0])[0] as Vector3).distance_to(w.global_position) < RANGE + float(_sphere(h[0])[1]):
+		focus = h[0]
+	if focus.is_empty() and digger:
+		return _dig(delta, firing)
+	if not firing or focus.is_empty():
+		_show(false, Vector3.ZERO)
+		return false
+	if overheated:
+		_show(false, Vector3.ZERO)
+		return true   # (the trigger held on the deposit: no rifle shot into it)
+	var hit: Vector3 = cam.global_position - cam.global_basis.z * float(h[1])
+	var mineral: String = focus["mineral"]
+	var data: Node = CosmosGame.data
+	if data.room_for(mineral) <= 0:
+		_say("Your pack is full")
+		_show(false, Vector3.ZERO)
+		return true
+	var hard := float(Mining.MINERALS.get(mineral, {"hard": 1.0})["hard"])
+	heat += HEAT * hard * delta
+	if heat >= 1.0:
+		heat = 1.0
+		overheated = true
+		_say("Mining beam overheated - let it cool")
+	_acc += RATE * delta
+	while _acc >= 1.0 and int(focus["units"]) > 0:
+		_acc -= 1.0
+		focus["units"] = int(focus["units"]) - 1
+		data.add_item(mineral, 1)
+		got[mineral] = int(got.get(mineral, 0)) + 1
+	_shape_of(focus)
+	_save(focus)
+	if int(focus["units"]) <= 0:
+		cosmos.hud.flash("%s deposit mined out - %d %s" % [_name(mineral), int(focus["max"]), _name(mineral)])
+		(focus["node"] as Node).queue_free()
+		deps.erase(focus["key"])
+		focus = {}
+		_show(false, Vector3.ZERO)
+		return true
+	(focus["node"] as GeometryInstance3D).set_instance_shader_parameter("heat", clampf(heat, 0.2, 1.0))
+	_show(true, hit)
+	return true
+
+
+## The digger, firing: a sphere carved out of the ground where the sights
+## meet it (its middle a little back along the beam: held on, it bores in
+## along it - down, or into a hillside), each DIG_EVERY s. True whenever it's
+## out and you fire (the rifle never shoots then).
+func _dig(delta: float, firing: bool) -> bool:
+	_dig_t -= delta
+	if not firing or overheated:
+		dig_at = Vector3.ZERO
+		_show(false, Vector3.ZERO)
+		return firing
+	var cam: Camera3D = cosmos.cam
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	var dir := -cam.global_basis.z
+	if _dig_t <= 0.0 or dig_at == Vector3.ZERO:
+		_dig_t = DIG_EVERY
+		dig_at = ground_hit(cam.global_position, dir, RANGE + cam.global_position.distance_to(w.global_position))
+		if dig_at != Vector3.ZERO and dig_at.distance_to(w.global_position) < RANGE:
+			var c := dig_at - planet.global_position - dir * DIG_R * 0.6
+			var d := c.normalized()
+			var top := c.length() - planet.radius
+			if planet.shape.cleared(d):
+				_say("Not in a town")
+				dig_at = Vector3.ZERO
+			elif top > planet.shape.height(d) - DIG_MOST and planet.shape.dig(d, DIG_R, top) >= 0:
+				digs += 1
+				planet.redig(c, DIG_R)
+		else:
+			dig_at = Vector3.ZERO
+	if dig_at == Vector3.ZERO:
+		_show(false, Vector3.ZERO)
+		return true
+	heat += DIG_HEAT * delta
+	if heat >= 1.0:
+		heat = 1.0
+		overheated = true
+		_say("Mining beam overheated - let it cool")
+	_show(true, dig_at)
+	return true
+
+
+## Where a line from `o` along `dir` first meets the solid ground within
+## `reach` (global; carves and all), or ZERO: steps of 0.6 m, then halved down to ~1 cm.
+func ground_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, reach: float) -> Vector3:
+	var shape: PlanetShape = planet.shape
+	var c := planet.global_position
+	var solid := func(t: float) -> bool:
+		return shape.density(o + dir * t - c) < 0.0
+	var t0 := 0.0
+	var t := 0.6
+	while t <= reach:
+		if solid.call(t):
+			for k in 6:
+				var mid := (t0 + t) * 0.5
+				if solid.call(mid):
+					t = mid
+				else:
+					t0 = mid
+			return o + dir * t
+		t0 = t
+		t += 0.6
+	return Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+func toggle_digger() -> void:
+	digger = not digger
+	dig_at = Vector3.ZERO
+	cosmos.hud.flash("Terrain digger" if digger else "Rifle")
+
+
+func _save(dep: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var all: Dictionary = CosmosGame.extra.get("dug", {})
+	var mine: Dictionary = all.get(_pid(), {})
+	mine[dep["key"]] = snappedf(float(dep["units"]) / maxf(1.0, float(dep["max"])), 0.001)
+	all[_pid()] = mine
+	CosmosGame.extra["dug"] = all
+
+
+static func _name(mineral: String) -> String:
+	return str(Items.ITEMS.get(mineral, {}).get("name", mineral.capitalize()))
+
+
+## The label the HUD shows for the deposit under the sights.
+func focus_text() -> String:
+	if focus.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	return "%s deposit - %d left" % [_name(focus["mineral"]), int(focus["units"])]
+
+
+var _said := -100000
+
+
+func _say(text: String) -> void:
+	if Time.get_ticks_msec() - _said > 4000:
+		_said = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+		cosmos.hud.flash(text)
+
+
+## The beam: from the walker's hand to where it cuts, flickering; a flare there.
+func _show(on: bool, hit: Vector3) -> void:
+	active = on
+	_beam.visible = on
+	_flare.visible = on
+	for k in deps:
+		if deps[k] != focus or not on:
+			(deps[k]["node"] as GeometryInstance3D).set_instance_shader_parameter("heat", 0.0)
+	if not on:
+		return
+	var w: Node3D = cosmos.walker
+	var u: Vector3 = w.up()
+	var hand: Vector3 = w.global_position + u * 1.3 + w.facing * 0.6 + w.facing.cross(u) * -0.25
+	var d := hit - hand
+	var L := d.length()
+	if L < 0.1:
+		_beam.visible = false
+		return
+	var y := d / L
+	var x := y.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(y.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	var z := x.cross(y)
+	var fl := 0.8 + 0.4 * sin(_t * 53.0) * sin(_t * 29.0)
+	_beam.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis(x * fl, y * L, z * fl), hand + d * 0.5)
+	_flare.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis().scaled(Vector3.ONE * (0.8 + 0.6 * fl)), hit)
hunks.title: CosmosDeposits (new)
hunks.note: Shared meshes built once; the set found on a worker when you've walked 18 m (paced by time); placed and dropped; the beam stepped each frame on foot; the digger's ground march and carve.

bubbles.text: A crystal cluster (9 hexagonal prisms on a lump of rock, crystal parts marked red in the vertex colour) and an ore boulder (two noise lumps) - shared by every deposit.

bubbles.at: static func _find(shape: PlanetShape, radius: float, sd: int, mix: Dictionary, local: Vector3, dug: Dictionary) -> Array:
bubbles.text: Worker: each 40 m cell near you seeded by hash([seed, key]) - a 55% chance, its ground point must fall in its own cell, a mineral picked by MIX's weights.
Minerals differ only by instance uniforms - one material, no per-mineral compile.

bubbles.at: func step(delta: float, firing: bool) -> bool:
bubbles.text: The mining beam: the deposit under the sights in reach, heat by hardness, units into the pack, shrinking, mined out and saved.
The digger: every DIG_EVERY s a carve centred 0.6 r back along the beam from where it meets the ground, so held on one spot it bores in.

bubbles.at: func ground_hit(o: Vector3, dir: Vector3, reach: float) -> Vector3:
bubbles.text: March through the density in 0.6 m steps, then six halvings (~1 cm) - finds dug walls and tunnels, not just the heightfield.
The save keeps each cell's share left; _find skips cells at 0.
